summary: Miaudow is a decision tool for farmers on drought-prone, low-yield rice land in Nghệ An, Việt Nam. It shows a few one-year crop sequences tested in a local field trial, including keeping rice, side by side as one card per plan: income, climate risk, water and land care. Each card is checked against past years using Vietnam's official hazard rules (heat, cold, drought, heavy rain), applied to NASA POWER daily weather and weighted by farmland from NASA MODIS land cover. The farmer picks what matters most, and the cards highlight it. Every number shows its source. Past years are never presented as forecasts.
details:
Miaudow is a phone-first web app, in Vietnamese and English, for farmers and extension officers on drought-prone, low-productivity rice land in Nghệ An, Việt Nam. Live app: https://miaudow.solareclipse.observer

What it does: a farmer answers three questions by tapping (what the field is like, which past years the family remembers, and what matters most: income, stability, water or care for the land). Miaudow then shows six one-year crop plans side by side: current practice and four alternatives tested in a 2020-21 field trial at Lưu Sơn, Đô Lương, plus local practice from a second study. Every card has the same rows: money as the trial reported it, irrigation water from the national standard TCVN 8641, how often the official drought, heat and heavy-rain conditions of Decision 18/2021/QĐ-TTg hit each crop in the chosen years, NASA root-zone soil wetness, care for the land, and the months the field is bare. The family's priority is highlighted, but plans are never ranked: Miaudow compares, it does not recommend.

How it works: NASA POWER daily weather (1990-2024) for every grid cell with farmland, weighted by a NASA MODIS farmland mask, is turned into the share of Nghệ An farmland that met each official hazard rule in each past year. A province rice-yield model was tested on 2016-2024 against three references; winter rice passes narrowly, spring rice fails, and we show both openly. Every number opens its source. Results are regional, and past years are never presented as forecasts.

Benefits and impact: farmers can weigh tested crop options against the bad years they remember, and take concrete questions to their extension officer.

Tools: Python (FastAPI, pandas, scikit-learn), React with TypeScript, Cesium and three.js for the 3D views, PostgreSQL for optional saved answers, deployed on Railway. Tests and security checks run on every change.
